metadata.title: Clicked like a madman and got 1 kill? Valorant, you’re drunk again
metadata.description:
Went full potato mode and somehow snagged a kill.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink life choices.
Valorant’s logic: handing out gifts nobody asked for.
If your aim’s a mystery too, you’re not alone.

Tap if your best kills felt like accidents too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
